# Level 5 — Senior Backend Engineer — Grade B (Cross-team design)

**Audience:** Senior engineers owning a subsystem.

**Graduation outcome:** Leads complex multi-team technical initiatives, evolves existing architectures safely, and balances delivery speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.

| Structured study | Recorded video | Lessons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 160–240 plus cross-team delivery experience h | 25–40 h | 65–95 |

## Capstone — Architecture Modernization (`SRB-CAP`)

Design and lead a simulated migration from a modular monolith to selected services, with phased releases, compatibility guarantees, observability, rollback plans, and measurable outcomes.

**Graduation gate:** Scenario-based migration review with stakeholder negotiation.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
